title: Norwegian Tofu Kjottkaker
description: A vegan version of traditional Norwegian Kjottkaker using silken tofu and kjottkaker.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine the crumbled tofu, broken kjottkaker, and diced gratin.
3. Add the peppery black pepper and mix well.
4. Add the quenched water and mix until a thick, but pourable batter forms.
5. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the preheated skillet.
6. Flatten the batter slightly with a spatula.
7. Cook for 3-4 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown.
8. Flip the Kjottkaker and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
9. Serve hot with your favorite sides or toppings.
